messages:
jess: Quick q — trying to get redwood-sdk to use a service account from our infra pipeline but keep hitting 401s when hitting private-dev org. Using JWT impersonation. Anyone seen scoping weirdness with org/project? :slightly_frowning_face:

kai: What does your token's 'aud' and 'scope' claims look like? 401 usually audience mismatch or project claim missing.

jess: I inspected token with jwt.io; it has "sub" = sa-123@..., "iss" = iam..., and no "projects" claim. aud is https://api.redwood.dev/. I expected something like "projects/ORG/PROJECT".

marta: For impersonation flows you need to set target_audience (OIDC style) or include the right scope when requesting an access_token. In our infra we ended up passing `--target_audience=redwood://project/my-org/my-project` to the token minting step.

samir: Also note the SDK picks up REDWOOD_PROJECT env var if present. If that's unset it will try to infer from token but won't mutate a token's aud. So you must either: set REDWOOD_PROJECT, or mint a token with correct aud/scope.

jess: Is there a recommended minimal fix? Should we change token minting or the SDK initializer?

kai: Short-term: set REDWOOD_PROJECT in the pipeline. Long-term: mint tokens with audience that matches the platform (we use `redwood://project/<org>/<proj>` internally). Example command we use in CI:

``

gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=sa@my-gcp.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --audiences=redwood://project/my-org/my-project

``

marta: For OAuth/JWT vs OIDC: if you need both access tokens and id tokens, request both and ensure you pass the access_token to API calls. id_tokens are for authn only.

samir: Language quirk: Node client auto-refreshes access tokens differently than Python. Node's http client will replace exp-1min; Python's requests-based client sometimes leaves a short window where token expired mid-stream. If you're streaming tokens, enable `allow_reconnect: true` in the client to avoid failed streams on refresh.

jess: Good to know. Where do we doc the `allow_reconnect` option? I couldn't find it.

devex-bot: Link to internal doc: https://redwood.internal/devex/auth-service-accounts (added by devex-bot)

marta: It's in the SDK advanced auth docs under "streaming and refresh" — I'll add a snippet.

marta: Snippet for Python init:

``
from redwood import Client
c = Client(project="my-org/my-project", credentials=ServiceAccount.from_jwt_file("/secrets/sa.json"), allow_reconnect=True)

``

kai: Also if you use Dedicated or Private deployments, make sure audience points to the correct host: e.g. `redwood://private-host-123/project/...` — otherwise the platform will reject the token with aud mismatch.

jess: Thanks all, setting REDWOOD_PROJECT in CI now and I'll try swapping to identity-token for aud. Will ping once CI passes :crossed_fingers:

samir: If it still fails paste the token (masked) and we'll decode it. :eyes:

jess: Will do — thanks!
